title: Skills drawer — taller, with a working handle

steps.path: Press the Browse skills button at the left of the message box (or type /)
steps.headline: Open the drawer, then drag its handle, click it, and close and reopen it. Does it behave the way you want?
steps.changed: It opens at 70% of the window instead of 45%. The bar at the top now works: drag it up or down to any height; click it to jump to full height, click again to come back; drag it most of the way down and let go to close. Every time it opens, it starts at 70% again.
steps.measured: 70% open height, full height leaves 48 px for the top bar
steps.notice: About three rows of skill cards show at once instead of one and a half.
steps.risk: It covers more of the conversation while open, and a stray click on the bar makes it jump to full height.
